checks.name: billing_and_catalog_readiness
checks.observation: The Play-installed harness reported Billing and catalog ready with two offers. Google Play returned the lifetime product at TRY 359.99 and the monthly base plan at TRY 119.99 per month.

checks.name: real_non_consumable_verification_and_restore
checks.observation: A real internal-test lifetime purchase verified with HTTP 200 and allowed access. A correlated restore request and unchanged logical-event count were not captured together.

checks.name: real_subscription_verification_and_restore
checks.observation: A zero-charge license-test monthly subscription verified with HTTP 200, restored with HTTP 200, and remained allowed with reason purchase_valid. A later restore advanced the safe client projection to version 18.

checks.name: rtdn_authoritative_state_change
checks.observation: Authenticated Google RTDN processing was observed to re-query provider state and converge a monthly entitlement from allowed to denied with reason expired. This is smoke evidence only because the full release scenario lacks correlated request and exactly-once counts.

checks.name: outbound_webhook_acceptance
checks.observation: The emitted entitlement.changed payload now includes its event_type. After deploying commit 3e75b38, the live receiver accepted and inserted a signed entitlement.changed event at 2026-09-03T20:47:07Z. No purchase tokens, order IDs, customer identifiers, or webhook secrets were retained in this evidence.

checks.name: invalid_token_no_write
checks.observation: An intentionally invalid token returned provider_error and did not increase verification or webhook counters, confirming no observation, entitlement, acknowledgement, or outbox write.
